import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Sort by (user_id, channel, event_ts, event_id) to establish order
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        na_position="last"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Compute time diff within each (user_id, channel) group without apply
    grp = events.groupby(["user_id", "channel"], sort=False)
    time_diffs = grp["event_ts"].diff()

    gap_threshold = pd.Timedelta(minutes=25)
    # Strict gap rule: a new session starts only when the gap STRICTLY
    # exceeds 25 minutes (gap > 25min). A gap of exactly 25 minutes keeps
    # the session alive.
    new_session = time_diffs.isna() | (time_diffs > gap_threshold)

    # Session number: cumulative sum of new_session flags within each group
    events["_new_session"] = new_session.astype(int)
    events["session_num"] = grp["_new_session"].cumsum()

    # Aggregate to get channel_sessions
    channel_sessions = events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num"],
        as_index=False
    ).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count")
    )

    # Ensure strictly 1-based ordering per user+channel by session_start order
    channel_sessions = channel_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_start"]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    channel_sessions["session_num"] = channel_sessions.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel"]
    ).cumcount() + 1

    channel_sessions = channel_sessions[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    return {"channel_sessions": channel_sessions}
